headline: United Rentals and the Graham and Courtney Rahal Foundation Raise $125,000 for SoldierStrong at Annual Drivers Tournament
summary: STAMFORD, Conn., Aug. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- United Rentals Inc., the world’s largest equipment rental company, today announced that its sponsorship of the Graham and Courtney Rahal Foundation’s 2026 Drivers Tournament raised $125,000 for SoldierStrong, a national nonprofit organization assisting America’s injured veterans in taking their next steps forward.
